editorial.completeInstitutionalAbstractActuallyRea: The increasing accessibility and affordability of spectral imaging technology have revolutionised computer vision, allowing for data capture across various wavelengths beyond the visual spectrum. This advancement has greatly enhanced the capabilities of computers and AI systems in observing, understanding, and interacting with the world. Consequently, new datasets in various modalities, such as infrared, ultraviolet, fluorescent, multispectral, and hyperspectral, have been constructed, presenting fresh opportunities for computer vision research and applications.

m2.completeInstitutionalAbstractActuallyRea: Object detection in remote sensing images is a challenging task due to diversified orientation, complex background, dense distribution and scale variation of objects. In this paper, we tackle this problem by proposing a novel multi-scale multi-level feature enhanced network (M2-Net) that integrates a Feature Map Enhancement (FME) module and a Feature Fusion Block (FFB) into Rotational RetinaNet. The FME module aims to enhance the weak features by factorizing the convolutional operation into two similar branches instead of one single branch, which helps to broaden receptive field with less parameters. This module is embedded into different layers in the backbone network to capture multi-scale semantics and location information for detection. The FFB module is used to shorten the information propagation path between low-level high-resolution features in shallow layers and high-level semantic features in deep layers, facilitating more effective feature fusion and object detection especially those with small sizes. Experimental results on three benchmark datasets show that our method not only outperforms many one-stage detectors but also achieves competitive accuracy with lower time cost than two-stage detectors.
m2.registeredTitle: M<sup>2</sup>-Net: A Multi-scale Multi-level Feature Enhanced Network for Object Detection in Optical Remote Sensing Images

primer.rationale: 完整v2直接综述HSI采集、标定、处理、学习与应用，实质内容含四扫描模式、恢复/增强、PCA/MNF、监督分类、端元与丰度估计以及跨域应用。只赋“高光谱研究综述”，不把介绍的算法、仪器、数据集或未来三维展望当该文原创贡献，也不加入三维专题。Table3含MODIS等多光谱/点光谱条目，不按整表扩展项目收录范围。
primer.datasets: 本文是方法Primer，不提供统一新基准或采集实验。Table2举EnMAP242带420–2450nm/30m、PRISMA239带420–2450nm/30m、AVIRIS-NG425带380–2450nm/1–5m、NEON AOP426带380–2450nm/~1m及USGS/EcoSIS/SPECCHIO等点光谱库。Table3跨领域列Pavia、Cuprite、Indian Pines、Salinas、Hyper-Skin、医学/食品/文物数据和HOTC16带视频等代表资料；这些规格仅为v2所载、未逐项核原始数据。AOD-MODIS明确12通道，不按HSI纳入；纯点光谱也不自动当成像数据。
primer.experimentSetting: v2全24页与99参考条目实际读，四原图视觉核对，属于综述及概念/例示分析。Fig3D列KNN/SVM/RF在原始、PCA和MNF表示上的分类图，给KNN降维维数曲线；只称城市示例，未交代具体场景身份、输入有效带、训练/测试数量与比例、划分种子、重复次数及超参数。Table1平台属性和Table2/3资源目录不是新实测对照；2015–2025任务比例未给可复核检索式或统计样本。
primer.conclusions: 作者提出从硬件设计、多传感器协调和HSI中心多模态联合建模出发的3J展望，并强调标定/采集元数据、物理差异、数据共享与跨域泛化。Fig3D及正文示例：原始KNN OA91.21%，PCA少数主成分接近该值，MNF约96%；只保留例示趋势，不作可复现优势或跨数据结论。任务统计图分类62%、解混9%是作者2015–2025示意统计，检索口径未给；OFA单带等效压缩、HSI agents及全视角几何成像是远期设想，没有相应模型、设备或实验验证。
primer.limitations: 全文级只对应固定v2；正式Nature Reviews Methods Primers6(2026)19不在白名单，链接仅作相关版本线索，正式全文未读，不误作Nature Methods。正文/参考书目和Table3包含纯MS MODIS12通道、点光谱库及部分其他模态，引用或表列不自动符合HSI来源/输入范围。Table1把平台一般性能写成概括范围；Table3各资料版本/尺寸/传感器未逐项核原始，不能替代标准数据集记录；分类场景、抽样/空间隔离、重复及软件参数未提供，91.21%/~96%仅例示。Eq4的J(X)未显式依赖所选S，Eq5最大化未写单位范数约束；Eq8印Σn w=λΣs w却把λ称SNR并按降序，按所定义协方差对应噪声/信号比，方向疑点保留不替作者改式；Eq12联合优化E/A但左边仅A。Fig3图注(C)/(D)面板描述不一致。Table3 Cuprite写HYDICE且引用1997特定采集，不能移植为常用AVIRIS场景；Pavia尺寸与具体版本缺来源交代。3D谱空立方体不是几何三维；论文区分伪3D并提出未来多视角，不称已经实现OFA、实时或临床验证。
